About MonA

Where the mountain meets the easel.

At MonA, we believe every young artist deserves to be seen, heard and celebrated.

MonA stands for Mountain & Art. We are the Mountain House Society of Fine Arts, a collective of young artists who celebrate and empower one another, building confidence and finding a voice. We offer everyone a place to share their perspectives and ideas, and through art, we hope to bring our community closer together.

Each year MonA hosts an art exhibition with a showing for elementary, middle and high school artists. Every showing opens with a reception and award show, and artists can earn rosette ribbons and awards.

MonA also hosts museum field trips, so young artists can explore and be inspired by art together.

Community fundraising pays for the display boards, ribbons and award money.
